summary: Mint Incorporation Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its August 18, 2026 Class A and extraordinary general meetings. Shareholders approved increasing Class B voting rights from 20 to 200 votes per share and adopting amended articles, increasing authorized share capital from 28 million to 280 million shares. However, on August 24, 2026, all Class B shareholders withdrew their class consent, nullifying the Class Rights Variation and amended articles. No transaction was proposed; the filing is a routine meeting-result and corporate-governance update, not a special situation.
